brief:
Shehab Wire examined Benjamin Netanyahu's political conduct since October 7, analyzing how the Israeli prime minister has leveraged ongoing conflicts and internal divisions to maintain his grip on office. The analysis details accumulated military and deterrence setbacks alongside mounting political losses.

Netanyahu faces escalating confrontations with political opponents even as his government grapples with strategic failures on multiple fronts, according to the outlet's assessment of his administration's performance in the months since the war began.

title: Netanyahu uses war, crisis to cling to power amid military failures
